scheme_name: Incentive Assistance to Scheduled Tribe Farmers to Increase the Area, Production and Productivity of Sugarcane Farming
other_conditions: Applicant must be engaged in sugarcane cultivation
For the 10% incentive, farmer must demonstrate excellent production using high-quality seeds, agricultural inputs, and modern farming practices
Applicant must specify the name of the Sugar Co-operative Society where they will register the sugarcane crop cultivation
benefits_summary: Cash assistance of ₹10,000 per hectare for sugarcane sowing and an additional 10% extra per metric ton for production exceeding 70 tonnes per hectare, up to 500 hectares.
